name: IBM Cloudant

evidence.nosql: C02: primary type is managed JSON document database; D01: REST document access and Mango queries

line: Managed JSON document database with CouchDB-compatible APIs and search.

free.text: Lite: 1 GB; 20 reads/s, 10 writes/s; legacy 30-day idle deletion rule unclear

cells.regions: Dallas, London, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Sydney, Mumbai, and more
cells.selfhost: No, IBM Cloudant is hosted; CouchDB is separate

sql.math: The guide gives an approximate reference of $76.65 a month. The current Dallas capacity price and 5 GB of transfer are not verified.
Even when idle, one Standard capacity block is still reserved. The current regional price and the exact 730-hour charge are unknown.

files.math: The storage subtotal is $80.64, but the region it is based on is unknown. File requests and transfer have no price.

jobs.math: Cloudant stores documents and does not run background workers
